Name: Armored Overhaul 3.7.0
Description: Bastion, Maelstrom and FRV upgrades, each its own option: tank top speed, engine torque, grip, steering, throttle response, suspension and stability; a collision damage boost for ramming; a faster Maelstrom gun with all its ammo on one belt; 360-degree MBT turrets with traverse, elevation, gun depression and gun raise; an autoloader; driving from the gunner seat; gunner camera distance; FRV stability; FRV run-flat tires; a vehicle indicator; and more than one vehicle in your loadout. With the Mod Options Menu, the options can be changed in game. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v19 or newer.

Options.Name: Tank Top Speed
Options.Description: A higher top speed and quicker acceleration for the Bastion and Maelstrom, forward and in reverse. Changes the tank you're in at once.

SubOptions.Name: Fast (x1.1)
SubOptions.Description: A tenth more engine speed and pulling power.

SubOptions.Name: Faster (x1.15)
SubOptions.Description: About a sixth more engine speed and pulling power.

SubOptions.Name: Fastest (x1.3)
SubOptions.Description: Three tenths more engine speed and pulling power.

Options.Name: Tank Engine Torque
Options.Description: More pull off the line and up slopes for the Bastion and Maelstrom. Top speed stays the game's unless Tank Top Speed is on too.

SubOptions.Name: Strong (x1.2)
SubOptions.Description: A fifth more engine torque.

SubOptions.Name: Stronger (x1.35)
SubOptions.Description: About a third more engine torque.

SubOptions.Name: Strongest (x1.5)
SubOptions.Description: Half again the engine torque.

Options.Name: Tank Grip
Options.Description: Less sliding on slopes and in turns for the Bastion and Maelstrom.

SubOptions.Name: Moderate (x1.2)
SubOptions.Description: A fifth more grip.

SubOptions.Name: Strong (x1.35)
SubOptions.Description: About a third more grip.

SubOptions.Name: Maximum (x1.5)
SubOptions.Description: Half again the grip.

Options.Name: Tank Steering
Options.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom start and stop turning sooner.

SubOptions.Name: Responsive (x1.25)
SubOptions.Description: A quarter quicker.

SubOptions.Name: Quick (x1.5)
SubOptions.Description: Half again as quick.

SubOptions.Name: Sharp (x2)
SubOptions.Description: Twice as quick: the tanks snap into turns.

Options.Name: Tank Throttle Response
Options.Description: Snappier throttle, brake and gear changes for the Bastion and Maelstrom.

SubOptions.Name: Quick
SubOptions.Description: Twice as fast; half the gear change pause.

SubOptions.Name: Quicker
SubOptions.Description: Four times as fast; a fifth of the pause.

SubOptions.Name: Instant
SubOptions.Description: Instant throttle and brake; no gear change pause.

Options.Name: Tank Stability
Options.Description: Downforce keeps the Bastion and Maelstrom planted over crests and bumps instead of floating.

SubOptions.Name: Stable
SubOptions.Description: Weighs 1.5 times as much at 45 km/h.

SubOptions.Name: Steady
SubOptions.Description: Weighs twice as much at 45 km/h.

SubOptions.Name: Planted
SubOptions.Description: Weighs three times as much at 45 km/h.

Options.Name: Tank Collision Demolition Boost
Options.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom break walls, fences and small buildings when they ram them at speed (demolition force 30 to 40; the game: 25 to 35).

Options.Name: Maelstrom Fire Rate
Options.Description: Hold reload in the Maelstrom's gun seat and right click to pick 1200, 1800 or 2400 rounds a minute (the game: 1200).

Options.Name: Maelstrom Single Belt
Options.Description: All 2,100 rounds of the Maelstrom's main gun on one belt: it never reloads.

Options.Name: Tank MBT Turrets
Options.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom turrets turn all the way round, or half way, like a main battle tank's. Only you see them turn.

SubOptions.Name: 360 (all the way round)
SubOptions.Description: The turret turns all the way round.

SubOptions.Name: 180 (90 each side)
SubOptions.Description: Up to 90 degrees either side.

Options.Name: Tank MBT Turrets for Remodels
Options.Description: Only for a mod that remodels the Bastion or Maelstrom (skins work with Tank MBT Turrets as is). To use it: turn Tank MBT Turrets off, pick the choice for your remodel, then Purge & Deploy. Not every remodel mod has been tested with it.

SubOptions.Name: Off
SubOptions.Description: No remodel: Tank MBT Turrets is used.

SubOptions.Name: Bastion Remodel 360 Turret
SubOptions.Description: A Bastion remodel made for this mod's turning turret: both turrets turn.

SubOptions.Name: Bastion Remodel Vanilla Turret
SubOptions.Description: A Bastion remodel with the game's turret: it stays as is, and only the Maelstrom's turret turns.

SubOptions.Name: Maelstrom Remodel 360 Turret
SubOptions.Description: A Maelstrom remodel made for this mod's turning turret: both turrets turn.

SubOptions.Name: Maelstrom Remodel Vanilla Turret
SubOptions.Description: A Maelstrom remodel with the game's turret: it stays as is, and only the Bastion's turret turns.

Options.Name: Tank Suspension
Options.Description: Longer wheel travel and firmer damping keep the tracks on the ground and the hull calm over bumps. Applies to tanks called in after a change.

SubOptions.Name: Balanced
SubOptions.Description: Half a meter of travel, damped half again as much as the game's.

SubOptions.Name: Planted
SubOptions.Description: Firmer, about twice the game's damping and the lowest center of gravity: the calmest ride.

Options.Name: Tank Turret Traverse
Options.Description: How fast the Bastion and Maelstrom turrets turn side to side (the game: 25 degrees a second).

SubOptions.Name: Quick (x1.5)
SubOptions.Description: 37.5 degrees a second.

SubOptions.Name: Fast (x2)
SubOptions.Description: 50 degrees a second.

SubOptions.Name: Very fast (x3)
SubOptions.Description: 75 degrees a second.

Options.Name: Tank Turret Elevation
Options.Description: How fast the Bastion and Maelstrom guns move up and down (the game: 35 degrees a second).

SubOptions.Name: Quick (x1.25)
SubOptions.Description: About 44 degrees a second.

SubOptions.Name: Fast (x1.5)
SubOptions.Description: 52.5 degrees a second.

SubOptions.Name: Very fast (x2)
SubOptions.Description: 70 degrees a second.

Options.Name: Tank Gun Depression
Options.Description: How far down the Bastion and Maelstrom guns aim (the game: 3 degrees below level).

SubOptions.Name: Low (6 deg below)
SubOptions.Description: 6 degrees below level.

SubOptions.Name: Lower (10 deg below)
SubOptions.Description: 10 degrees below level.

SubOptions.Name: Lowest (15 deg below)
SubOptions.Description: 15 degrees below level.

Options.Name: Tank Gun Raise
Options.Description: How far up the Bastion and Maelstrom guns aim (the game: 25 degrees above level).

SubOptions.Name: High (30 deg above)
SubOptions.Description: 30 degrees above level.

SubOptions.Name: Higher (45 deg above)
SubOptions.Description: 45 degrees above level.

SubOptions.Name: Highest (60 deg above)
SubOptions.Description: 60 degrees above level.

Options.Name: Tank Autoloader
Options.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom main gun reloads by itself when it runs dry.

Options.Name: Gunner Drive
Options.Description: Drive from the gunner seat when the driver seat is empty: movement keys or the left stick drive, shift and CTRL change gear, Space is the handbrake, F the horn, Mouse 3 the Maelstrom's smoke. Online, press forward or back to get the tank back after someone else drove.

SubOptions.Name: Tanks and FRV
SubOptions.Description: Both the tanks and the M-102 and M-104 FRVs.

SubOptions.Name: Tanks
SubOptions.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom, from the gunner seat.

SubOptions.Name: FRV
SubOptions.Description: The M-102 and M-104 FRVs, from their gunner seats.

Options.Name: Driver Panel
Options.Description: Needs Gunner Drive. Shows the gear, rpm, speed, fuel and smoke rounds while you drive from the gunner seat. Only you see it.

Options.Name: Tank Gunner Camera
Options.Description: Puts the tanks' gunner camera lower and further back. Scroll to move it, and from the closest point scroll on to zoom in.

SubOptions.Name: Close (about 1.5 m back)
SubOptions.Description: The game's distance, 1.4 m up (the game: 2 m).

SubOptions.Name: Far (about 3.5 m back)
SubOptions.Description: 1.4 m up.

SubOptions.Name: Farther (about 5 m back)
SubOptions.Description: 1.4 m up.

SubOptions.Name: Farthest (about 6.5 m back)
SubOptions.Description: 1.4 m up: the widest view.

Options.Name: FRV Stability
Options.Description: Keeps the M-102, M-103 and M-104 FRVs on their wheels over rough ground, jumps and hard turns.

SubOptions.Name: Stable
SubOptions.Description: Stays upright, with extra tire grip; 30% heavier.

SubOptions.Name: Mild
SubOptions.Description: About half the change; 17% heavier.

SubOptions.Name: Planted
SubOptions.Description: The most grip and the lowest center of mass; 45% heavier.

Options.Name: FRV Run-Flat Tires
Options.Description: The M-102, M-103 and M-104 FRVs' tires never pop. Works when you host or play alone.

Options.Name: Vehicle Indicator
Options.Description: A small outline shows where your gun points and your vehicle's health, the FRVs' tires, and in the driver seat the gunner's ammo. Only you see it.

Options.Name: Vehicle Loadout
Options.Description: Pick more than one tank, exosuit or FRV in your loadout.
